title: Edge to Edge (E2E)

fixes.find: { yAxis: 62, label: "Stop Loss — Below Cloud", color: "#ff2e88" }
fixes.replaceWith: { yAxis: 72, label: "Stop Loss — Below Cloud", color: "#ff2e88" }
fixes.reason: Lesson text: 'Stop Loss: below the cloud for bullish E2E'. The candles walk start=70 with leg lows of 88/86/79/112, so the visible floor is ~70 (wick margin ~68-69). A stop line at 62 sits BELOW the rendered band and clips off-chart, so the stop is never seen. Raise to 72 — just below the structural pullback low / start and still well below the cloud bottom edge (entry at 78) — so the pink stop pill renders inside the band and remains 'below the cloud'. Label and pink #ff2e88 unchanged.

edits.reason: Only a coordinate fix is needed. The stop-loss level is taught ('stop loss below the cloud') and already drawn, but clips off the bottom; correcting the yAxis makes it visible. The two Tenkan/Kijun additions the auditor proposed are REJECTED — this chart has indicator:"ichimoku", so the engine already computes and renders the Tenkan-sen and Kijun-sen lines dynamically from the OHLC (lt-ta.js computeIchimoku). Adding static markLines at guessed prices (82, 76) would draw a second, conflicting fast/base line that does not match the computed value. The 'thing taught' for Entry Options 2 and 3 (Tenkan retest, Kijun S/R flip) is therefore already visible on the chart as the indicator's own lines.

fixes.find: { yAxis: 86, label: "Top Edge — E2E Target",  color: "#ffcc00" }
fixes.replaceWith: { yAxis: 86, label: "Top Edge of Kumo Cloud",  color: "#ffcc00" }
fixes.reason: The quiz question asks 'Where is the defined price target for this E2E setup?' and the correct answer is 'the opposite edge of the Kumo cloud (top edge)'. A pre-cut markLine that literally reads 'E2E Target' on the top edge gives the answer away before the learner chooses. Relabel to 'Top Edge of Kumo Cloud' so the line stays as legitimate decision context (the cloud's upper edge) without naming it the target. yAxis 86 and gold #ffcc00 unchanged. The post-answer revealMarkPoint 'Opposite Edge — E2E Complete!' (idx 19) already carries the target conclusion after the user answers.

edits.reason: Pre-reveal spoiler fix only. The bottom-edge line 'Bottom Edge — E2E Entry' (74, teal) is left unchanged — it is valid decision context (where price closed inside the cloud) and does not reveal the target, so the auditor's optional 'confirm no change' item is not an edit and is dropped. No new pre-cut annotations added, so the cut scenario is not otherwise spoiled.

notes: introChart is complete: it teaches the 3 prerequisites + entry + opposite-edge target, all of which are drawn (markLines for both cloud edges; markPoints for each prereq, entry, travel, and target). lessonChart needed only the stop-loss yAxis fix (62->72) to stop it clipping. quiz.chart needed only the top-edge relabel to remove the answer spoiler. The auditor's two Tenkan/Kijun markLine ADDS on lessonChart were rejected because indicator:"ichimoku" already renders those lines dynamically; static guessed-price lines would contradict the computed indicator. All accepted fixes preserve existing colors and the chapter's teal=long/gold=target convention.
